environment.E038_CONTROL_DIR: Fresh nonexistent absolute output directory; existing parent. Original and candidate use distinct directories.
environment.E038_CONTROL_EXPECT_FAST_PATH: 0 for original, 1 for candidate; mandatory native predicate assertion.

host.stores: Exactly regret0, regret1, strategy0, strategy1. Each: tag:u32 (1 I16, 2 U16), q_count:u64, q_count 2-byte raw words, scale_count:u64, scale_count raw f32-bit u32 words. Require EOF after store4; preserve signed I16 two-complement words.

device.arenas: Exactly regret0, regret1, strategy0, strategy1. Each: count:u64 then count raw f32-bit u32 words. Require EOF after arena4. Lengths equal actual plan device_elements[player]. Every strategy word must have bits0.

query.records: All action nodes in ascending ID to EOF: node:u32, player:u32, nh:u32, na:u32, followed by nh*na f32-bit u32 values from actual solved_strategy_into. No record-count prefix. Require exact EOF and at least one nonuniform action strategy.

binary_codecs.save: Existing Solver::save format, compared as full bytes. Saves decode compressed data and do not preserve raw U16 q by format; complete host images separately preserve those words.

native_assertions: Nonzero deterministic U16 q with all scale bits +0; every host word preserved through actual constructor, CPU queries and saves.
Actual full layout and actual compact layout with nonempty inactive siblings for both players; actual device lengths match finalized plan.
Compact U16 inactive snapshots remain positive-zero sentinels; finite distinct I16 snapshots are nonempty.
Actual first and repeat full sync_to_cpu execute ArenaLayout.write. Repeat host image equals first readback; actual symmetric materialization changes compact host data.
All four device arenas remain byte-identical through all four captures; both strategy arrays contain exact positive-zero bits.
Both layout solver owners synchronize before drop; each retained own context error slot is checked after solver destruction.

cross_arm_comparison.gate: Require successful original and candidate runs, both exact unit summaries, all three ordered markers, no cleanup error, exact 27-file inventories and descriptor byte lengths before comparison.
cross_arm_comparison.raw: All 26 files under matching full/compact paths must be byte-identical across original and candidate; decode every raw image to EOF and validate geometry.
cross_arm_comparison.json: evidence.json and marker payloads must be identical after removing only layouts[*].u16_zero_fast_path (or result.u16_zero_fast_path for layout markers). Original must be false and candidate true before removal. No other field may differ.
cross_arm_comparison.intra_arm: pre/post host/query/save exact; all four GPU images per layout exact; first/repeat host exact; full materialization no-op and compact materialization changes host.

limits: This is upload/readback correctness, not solver convergence or timing evidence. No iterations, exploitability, or custom GPU kernel.
Original and candidate are independent processes using the same attachment; no CPU mirror of production upload/decode.
Signed/F32/bad-scale/reused/snapshot unit coverage in the sealed sources is unchanged.
Two layouts share one fixed Spot configuration; geometry is asserted at runtime, never silently substituted.
Existing E038 production archive remains immutable; control attachment is test-only and excluded from eventual performance binaries.
filter_routing: Root reuses the established harness with the complete qualified filter, without --exact. Exactly one selected pass and the specified filtered count remain mandatory.
